title: End card held with a freeze frame
caption: The last nine seconds of the launch film before its fade, with mgvideo freeze holding the end card for three more seconds so the call to action stays on screen; a small label marks the frozen stretch.
prompt: The end card of ../videos/01-branded-promo.mp4 is on screen too briefly. Take 4 s to 13 s (before the fade to black) and hold the last frame for 3 more seconds with silent audio padding, so the clip ends on "Say hello at magnifito.com". Mark the held part with a small "Freeze: end frame held 3 s" label in Geist (labels.svg, fonts/) that fades in when the freeze starts.
commands: ffmpeg -i work/held.mp4 -loop 1 -t 12 -i work/labels.png -filter_complex "[1:v]format=rgba,fade=t=in:st=9:d=0.3:alpha=1[lab];[0:v][lab]overlay=0:0:shortest=1,format=yuv420p[v]" -map [v] -map 0:a -c:v libx264 -crf 16 -preset medium -c:a aac -b:a 160k work/final.mp4
